category_definitions.BINDING_OR_DOMAIN_UNRESOLVED: Required input binding or semantic domain cannot be defensibly reconstructed under the frozen protocol.
category_definitions.COMPLEX_CONTAINER_SEMANTICS: Business semantics depend materially on complex mappings, sets, sequences, or nested container structures.
category_definitions.FRAMEWORK_OR_EXTERNAL_EFFECTS: Semantics depend on framework services, HTTP responses, signals, cache/Redis, database/ORM behavior, or external I/O.
category_definitions.NESTED_OR_HIGHER_ORDER_LOGIC: Nested helpers, closures, comprehensions, higher-order behavior, or dynamically structured control flow outside the frozen formal subset.
category_definitions.NON_SCALAR_OR_REFERENCE_SEMANTICS: Observable result is a reference, date, object, collection, response, or otherwise lacks a defensible scalar business projection.
category_definitions.OTHER_FROZEN_SCOPE_LIMITATION: Explicit frozen evidence establishes non-certifiability, but the limitation does not fit a more specific category.
category_definitions.STATEFUL_SIDE_EFFECTING_LOGIC: Object/model state mutation, transactional mutation, initializer semantics, or side-effect-dominated logic.
category_definitions.UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE_SEMANTICS: Required language/AST construct lies outside the frozen symbolic semantics.

method: Deterministic normalization of frozen candidate-level reason_code and reviewed reason evidence. This supersedes the earlier generic keyword taxonomy.
